method: Fit a fixed-position unit-peak restoring-beam profile plus a planar background on native primary-beam-corrected image pixels. Restrict measured primary beams to response of at least 0.20 at the target and compare controls at similar response. For larger beam maps, the depth comes from the finite, local corrected pixels without a separate beam gate. Use the robust local blank-position dispersion and require at least 25 controls. Combine only within each observation member, weighing spectral windows by inverse local variance and including the measured scatter of combination controls. The neighbor flux uses a separate fixed-position fit, with the target noise scale for comparison.
scope: Point-source sensitivity and signed continuum measurements in sampled historical datasets. The recovery estimate transfers an added matching-profile flux onto measured control residuals. Neighbor flux estimates may covary with the target in broad beams. Absolute calibration and resolved-source sensitivity are not included. Different spectral windows and beams do not measure a common passband. No spectral lines are inferred.
